kashika: संबोधने या प्रथमा तदन्तं शब्दरूपमामन्त्रितसंज्ञं भवति। तथा चैवोदाहृतम्। आमन्त्रितप्रदेशाः — <<आमन्त्रितं पूर्वमविद्यमानवत्>> [[८.१.७२]] इत्येवमादयः॥
kashikaEnglish: A nominative word in the sense of address is called āmantrita (vocative).
englishFull:
A word ending in the 1st case-affix, when used for addressing, is called आमन्त्रित (vocative).

This is a technical definition for vocative forms.
